title: TTG Asia Media
description: TTG Asia is a leading travel trade business resource in the Asia-Pacific region, established in 1974. The company provides a comprehensive range of services and information related to travel, including hotels, transportation, airlines, and cruises. Its intended clients include travel professionals and businesses within the tourism industry looking for insights and resources to enhance their operations. TTG Asia also features news, trade calendars, and branded content to support the growth of the travel sector.
